reason: When I need a plumber or a tutor, I post in our apartment WhatsApp group and go with whoever a neighbour vouches for - that costs me nothing and someone I know is standing behind the recommendation. I don't see why I'd start opening an app for that.
objection: This feels like it's made for English-speaking city people, not people like me - even if it's in Tamil, I don't know this app, I don't know these freelancers, and a 'verified' badge on a screen isn't the same as my neighbour saying 'I used him last month, he's good.'
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my own building's WhatsApp group actually used it and said it worked out well, I might try it once myself.
